name: diarize-judge
description: Speaker-label judge: maps VAD segment indexes to remote-speaker labels as index-to-label JSON only, with no transcript text. Local Summarizer only (temperature 0.0, max_tokens 256). Not a summary template: it takes diarization JSON rather than transcript text, so summary-template discovery skips it by design.

labels.description: Map of segment index (as a string) to speaker label ('others' or 'others:<1..N>').
